nrIncident.summary: Reduced weekday service between Aylesbury Vale Parkway and London Marylebone via Amersham expected until the end of the day on Friday 27 November
nrIncident.routes: Between Aylesbury Vale Parkway / Aylesbury and London Marylebone
nrIncident.message:
There is an ongoing fault with the signalling system between Aylesbury Vale Parkway and Amersham.
Fewer trains are able to operate between these stations on weekdays, and as a result some services will be cancelled or revised. Those trains that do run between Aylesbury Vale Parkway / Aylesbury and London Marylebone may be subject to delays of up to 10 minutes.
This is expected until the end of the day on Friday 27 November.
Customer advice:
A revised weekday timetable has been implemented. As a result, the following will be in place:
Southbound
• The 06:02 Aylesbury to London Marylebone service will be cancelled
• The 06:33 Aylesbury to London Marylebone service will be cancelled
• The 07:00 Aylesbury Vale Parkway to London Marylebone service will start at Aylesbury at 07:00
• The 07:37 Aylesbury to London Marylebone service will be cancelled
• The 08:09 Aylesbury Vale Parkway to London Marylebone service will be cancelled
• The 09:40 Aylesbury Vale Parkway to London Marylebone service will be cancelled
• The 13:10 Aylesbury Vale Parkway to London Marylebone service will be cancelled
• An additional 13:45 Aylesbury to London Marylebone service will run
Northbound
• The 06:46 Aylesbury to Aylesbury Vale Parkway service will be cancelled
• The 06:35 London Marylebone to Aylesbury Vale Parkway service will start at Aylesbury
• The 06:52 London Marylebone to Aylesbury Vale Parkway service will terminate at Aylesbury
• The 08:27 London Marylebone to Aylesbury Vale Parkway service will terminate at Aylesbury
• The 11:57 London Marylebone to Aylesbury Vale Parkway service will be cancelled
• An additional 12:27 London Marylebone to Aylesbury service will run
• The 15:57 London Marylebone to Aylesbury service will be cancelled
• The 17:11 London Marylebone to Aylesbury service will be cancelled
• The 17:41 London Marylebone to Aylesbury service will be cancelled
• The 18:11 London Marylebone to Aylesbury service will be cancelled
• The 18:41 London Marylebone to Aylesbury service will be cancelled
The 17:30 and 18:30 London Marylebone to Aylesbury Vale Parkway services will call additionally at Amersham.
If your service is cancelled, you should instead travel on the next available service.
Ticket flexibility:
If your train is cancelled, you will be able to travel on an alternative service operated by any other participating train company, either two hours before or two hours after the original departure time of the cancelled service, in order to reach your destination.
If you decide not to travel or cannot complete your journey due to cancellations, you are entitled to a full refund from your original point of sale.
For further information and guidance please contact your train company or speak to a member of railway staff.
Check before you travel:
You can check your journey until Thursday 26 November using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner. If you wish to travel on Friday 27 November, please check back later.
Compensation:
You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
